jp: 大きなウシの姿の[n]キョウアクなデビルで[n]カイリキのもちぬし[n]手にもったカナボウで[n]敵も味方も[n]ふきとばす[end]
en: A vicious bull-shaped devil with incredible strength. Its iron club sends foes and friends alike flying.[end]

jp: 夜に　あらわれる[n]おそろしい　デビル[n]タマゴに　入った[n]神への　プレゼント[n]なにが入っているのか[n]だれも　知らない[end]
en: A fearsome devil that appears at night. It brings the gods a present inside an egg, but nobody knows what's in it.[end]

jp: まいにち　太陽が[n]あらわれるとともに[n]やってくる船のデビル[n]あの世と　この世の[n]さかいめを[n]通ることができる[end]
en: A ship devil that comes every day as the sun rises. It can cross the border between this world and the next.[end]

jp: 熱い風に　乗せて[n]病気をはこんでくる[n]悪い　デビル[n]その病気に　かかると[n]ふつうの　方法では[n]なおせない[end]
en: An evil devil that carries sickness on hot winds. Once you catch its sickness, normal methods can't cure it.[end]

jp: 体の　上半分が馬[n]体の　下半分が魚の[n]水の　ヨウセイ[n]イタズラ　好きだけど[n]つかまえてしまえば[n]背中に　乗せてくれる[end]
en: A water fairy, horse on top and fish below. It loves pranks, but if you catch it, it'll let you ride on its back.[end]

jp: 寒いところに[n]住んでいて[n]悪い病気を[n]水の中から　ひろめる[n]魚の姿の[n]とても　悪いデビル[end]
en: A very evil, fish-shaped devil that lives in cold places and spreads terrible sickness through the water.[end]

jp: 人間に　武器と[n]魔法と　ケショウを[n]教えた　ナゾのデビル[n]人間を　助けようと[n]しているのかは[n]だれも　知らない[end]
en: A mysterious devil that taught humans weapons, magic and makeup. Nobody knows if it is trying to help them.[end]

jp: 寒い地方に住んでいて[n]イワの中に入っている[n]６本の足を持っている[n]キョウリュウの[n]ような　姿の[n]悪い　デビル[end]
en: An evil devil that lives inside rocks in cold lands. It looks like a dinosaur with six legs.[end]

jp: 商売はんじょうに[n]してくれるという[n]福の　神[n]釣っている　タイとは[n]何千年も　戦っている[n]ライバルらしい[end]
en: A god of good fortune who brings business success. The sea bream he fishes is said to be his rival of thousands of years.[end]

jp: 人間がキライな[n]キョウボウなヨウセイ[n]ボウシの　赤い色は[n]旅人を　おそった時の[n]血で　赤にそまった[n]という[end]
en: A violent fairy that hates humans. They say its hat was dyed red with the blood of travelers it attacked.[end]

jp: 雪のつもる　場所に[n]住んでいる　デビル[n]ぼうっとしていると[n]とりつかれてしまうが[n]こまっている　人間を[n]助けてくれる時もある[end]
en: A devil that lives in snowy places. Space out and it'll possess you, but sometimes it helps humans in trouble.[end]

jp: 火山の中に住んでいて[n]自分も　燃えている[n]ネズミの　デビル[n]カソの皮に[n]火をつけようとしても[n]絶対に　燃えない[end]
en: A mouse devil that lives inside volcanoes and is on fire itself. Try to set a Kaso's fur alight and it never burns.[end]

jp: 世界をほろぼす[n]力を持った[n]伝説のケモノ[n]眠りからさめた[n]その力は　だれにも[n]とめられない[end]
en: A legendary beast with the power to destroy the world. Now awake from its slumber, its power can't be stopped by anyone.[end]

jp: 強い力を持っていると[n]ウワサのナゾのデビル[n]人間にしれんをあたえ[n]それをのりこえた者は[n]新しい力を手に入れる[n]ことが　できるという[end]
en: A mysterious devil rumored to be very powerful. It gives humans trials, and those who pass them gain new power.[end]

jp: 鬼の兄弟のデビル[n]名前をよばれて返事[n]をすると　答えた者を[n]すいこんでしまう[n]不思議なひょうたんを[n]持っている[end]
en: One of the ogre brothers. It has a mysterious gourd that sucks in anyone who answers when their name is called.[end]

jp: 鬼の兄弟のデビル[n]キンカクといっしょに[n]わるぢえを考えては[n]旅人にいじわるを[n]している[end]
en: One of the ogre brothers. Together with Kinkaku, it thinks up wicked schemes to pester travelers.[end]

jp: すべての世界の　中で[n]１番よいといわれる[n]金色のたてがみの　馬[n]大空を　走り[n]金のたてがみが世界を[n]明るく　てらすという[end]
en: A golden-maned horse said to be the finest in all the worlds. It runs across the sky, and its golden mane lights up the world.[end]

jp: 世界に夜を運んでくる[n]白いたてがみの　馬[n]朝の霧は　この[n]フリンファクシが[n]作りだしていると[n]いわれている[end]
en: A white-maned horse that brings night to the world. They say the morning mist is made by Hrimfaxi.[end]

jp: タマシイをもった[n]人形として　作られる[n]ハズだったのに[n]失敗して[n]不完全な体になった[n]かなしい　デビル[end]
en: A sad devil that was meant to be a doll with a soul, but failed and ended up with an incomplete body.[end]

jp: アザラシの姿を[n]している[n]海の　ヨウセイ[n]本当の　姿は[n]男も　女も[n]とても美しい[end]
en: A sea fairy in the form of a seal. In their true forms, both the men and the women are very beautiful.[end]

jp: 小さな　鬼のデビル[n]いつも　悪いことを[n]考えているから[n]気をつけないと[n]イタズラに[n]ひっかけられてしまう[end]
en: A little ogre devil always thinking up mischief. If you're not careful, you'll fall for its pranks.[end]

jp: 人間に　たいじされた[n]悪いデビルのタマシイ[n]１体じゃ　弱いから[n]いつも　何体か[n]あつまってから[n]コウゲキしてくる[end]
en: The soul of an evil devil defeated by humans. One alone is weak, so they always gang up before they attack.[end]

jp: 空から　ふわふわ[n]落ちてくる[n]ナゾの　いきもの[n]おしろいのこなを[n]あげると　幸せに[n]してくれるという[end]
en: A mysterious creature that floats softly down from the sky. They say if you give it face powder, it brings you happiness.[end]

jp: 熱い風を　あやつって[n]病気をひろめた[n]悪い　デビル[n]長い　フウインから[n]めざめたが　力は[n]まだ　完全ではない[end]
en: An evil devil that spread sickness by controlling hot winds. It woke from a long seal, but its power is not yet complete.[end]

jp: 子供をさらって[n]食べていた[n]コワイデビル[n]フウインはとけたが[n]まだ　すべての力は[n]もどっていない[end]
en: A scary devil that kidnapped and ate children. Its seal is broken, but not all of its power has returned.[end]

jp: 長いフウインで[n]本当の力は　まだ[n]もどっていない[n]すこしずつ[n]体じゅうの目が[n]ひらいてきている[end]
en: After its long seal, its true power hasn't returned yet. Little by little, the eyes all over its body are opening.[end]

jp: フウインされていた[n]巨大な　ヘビ[n]まだ　本当の力は[n]もどっていないが[n]目から　かすかに[n]炎が　でてきている[end]
en: A giant snake that was sealed away. Its true power hasn't returned yet, but faint flames flicker from its eyes.[end]

jp: ずっと昔から[n]眠り　つづけていた[n]優しい　象の神[n]本当の力も[n]やさしさも　まだ[n]眠ったままでいる[end]
en: A gentle elephant god that has slept since long ago. Its true power and its kindness are both still asleep.[end]

jp: 長い時間　眠っていた[n]炎の剣を持つ　戦士[n]まだ　本当の力は[n]めざめていないが[n]剣のレーヴァティンは[n]めざめはじめている[end]
en: A warrior with a flame sword who slept a long time. His true power hasn't awakened, but his sword Laevatein is waking.[end]

jp: 長い　あいだ[n]フウインされていた[n]ライオンの姿の[n]もうじゅう[n]まだ　本当の力は[n]めざめていない[end]
en: A lion-shaped wild beast sealed away for a long time. Its true power has not yet awakened.[end]

jp: はるかな　昔に[n]力を　うばわれ[n]フウインされた[n]キョウアクな　象[n]まだ　本当の力は[n]めざめていない[end]
en: A vicious elephant robbed of its power and sealed away long ago. Its true power has not yet awakened.[end]

jp: はるかな　昔に[n]悪さをして[n]フウインされた[n]身軽な　トラのデビル[n]まだ　本当の力は[n]めざめていない[end]
en: A nimble tiger devil sealed away long ago for its misdeeds. Its true power has not yet awakened.[end]

jp: はるかな　昔に[n]フウインされた[n]地獄のこうしゃく[n]その強大な　力は[n]まだ　完全には[n]めざめていない[end]
en: A duke of Hell sealed away in the distant past. Its mighty power has not yet fully awakened.[end]

jp: はるかな　昔から[n]眠っていた[n]森を　守る[n]優しいデビル[n]まだ　本当の力は[n]もどっていない[end]
en: A gentle demon that has slept since ancient times, guarding the forest. Its true power has not yet returned.[end]

jp: 過去　現在　未来の[n]すべての時間の中に[n]存在し[n]人間の　生まれてから[n]死ぬまでの[n]すべてをみとどける神[end]
en: A god who exists in all of time, past, present and future, and watches over every human life from birth to death.[end]

jp: 時間を　あやつる[n]女神３姉妹の　長女[n]過去をあらわす神で[n]強い創造の力があり[n]命を生みだす力が[n]あるとも言われる[end]
en: Eldest of the three goddess sisters who rule time. Goddess of the past, with great creative power. Some say she can create life.[end]

jp: 時間を　あやつる[n]女神３姉妹の　次女[n]現在をあらわす神で[n]姉妹の中で１番[n]母性的な性格だと[n]言われている[end]
en: Second of the three goddess sisters who rule time. Goddess of the present, said to be the most motherly of the sisters.[end]

jp: 時間を　あやつる[n]女神３姉妹の　末女[n]未来をあらわす神で[n]死とハカイの力を[n]強く持っていると[n]言われている[end]
en: Youngest of the three goddess sisters who rule time. Goddess of the future, said to hold great power over death and destruction.[end]

jp: ネコのような姿を[n]していて　イヌの[n]声で　ほえるデビル[n]キゲンが悪いと　[n]炎を　はきだして[n]家をもやしてしまう[end]
en: A demon that looks like a cat and barks like a dog. When it's in a bad mood, it spits fire and burns houses down.[end]

jp: サウナに住んでいる[n]ユゲのデビル[n]おふろが大好きで[n]人間が　おふろから[n]あがったあとに[n]こっそり　はいる[end]
en: A steam demon that lives in saunas. It loves baths, and sneaks in for a soak after people get out.[end]

jp: 家の近くに住んでいて[n]人間を守ってくれる[n]心やさしい　デビル[n]全身が真っ白な毛で[n]おおわれていて[n]変身するのが大得意[end]
en: A kindhearted demon that lives near houses and protects people. Its whole body is covered in pure white fur, and it's great at shapeshifting.[end]

jp: 愛していた人に[n]うらぎられて[n]ヘビに変身した[n]女のデビル[n]口からはき出す[n]炎は鉄もとかす[end]
en: A woman betrayed by the one she loved, who turned into a snake demon. The fire she breathes can melt iron.[end]

jp: ゴビサバクに住む[n]口から毒をはき出す[n]イモムシの　デビル[n]その姿からは[n]想像できないほどの[n]スピードで移動する[end]
en: A caterpillar demon of the Gobi Desert that spits poison. It moves at a speed you'd never guess from its looks.[end]

jp: 青い炎を　はき出し[n]小さな羽をふるわせて[n]人間をビックリさせる[n]死んだ人間のウラミが[n]たまって　デビルに[n]なった[end]
en: It spits blue fire and flutters its little wings to startle people. It became a demon from the piled-up grudges of the dead.[end]

jp: モミの木に住んでいる[n]森のおじいさんデビル[n]きこりに切るべき木を[n]教えその通りにすると[n]たくさんのお金が[n]でてくる[end]
en: An old forest demon that lives in fir trees. It tells woodcutters which trees to cut, and if they do, lots of money comes out.[end]

jp: カエルの顔を　持つ[n]頭のいいデビル[n]魔法が　得意で[n]子供が生まれる時には[n]色々な　魔法で[n]お手伝いをする[end]
en: A clever demon with the face of a frog. It's good at magic, and helps with all sorts of spells when a child is born.[end]

jp: 真っ赤な　かみの毛を[n]していて人間の言葉を[n]研究している[n]オランウータンデビル[n]酒好きでよっぱらうと[n]上手におどりだす[end]
en: An orangutan demon with bright red hair that studies human language. It loves to drink, and dances pretty well when it's drunk.[end]

jp: クマの姿をしている[n]お金を守る　神さま[n]たくさんの　人間を[n]守るために　いつも[n]おおいそがしらしい[end]
en: A god of money in the form of a bear. Protecting so many people seems to keep it super busy all the time.[end]

jp: クマのきぐるみを[n]着ている　女神さま[n]手にもっている果物は[n]人間が　食べると[n]どんな　病気も[n]なおってしまう[end]
en: A goddess wearing a bear costume. The fruit in her hand cures any illness when a human eats it.[end]

jp: 死を　つかさどる[n]シカの　デビル[n]世界の中心にある[n]大事な木の葉っぱが[n]大好物で　神さまを[n]こまらせている[end]
en: A deer demon that rules over death. It loves eating the leaves of the great tree at the world's center, which troubles the gods.[end]

jp: オーディンのカタに[n]とまっているカラス[n]世界中の　ウワサを[n]あつめるのが　仕事で[n]ムニンとは　兄弟[n]思想を　つかさどる[end]
en: A crow that perches on Odin's shoulder. Its job is gathering rumors from all over the world. Brother of Munin, it rules over thought.[end]

jp: オーディンのカタに[n]とまっているカラス[n]世界中の　ウワサを[n]あつめるのが　仕事で[n]フギンとは　兄弟[n]きおくを　つかさどる[end]
en: A crow that perches on Odin's shoulder. Its job is gathering rumors from all over the world. Brother of Hugin, it rules over memory.[end]

jp: 人間に　化けるのが[n]得意な　コギツネの[n]デビル[n]手に　もっている[n]タイコは　お母さんの[n]大事な　カタミ[end]
en: A little fox demon that's good at disguising itself as a human. The drum it carries is a precious keepsake from its mother.[end]

jp: 大地を　つかさどる[n]動物たちの　女王[n]戦争が　大好きで[n]ライオンに　のって[n]戦場を　かけまわる[end]
en: Queen of the animals, ruling over the earth. She loves war, and rides a lion across the battlefield.[end]

jp: 大地を守護する女神で[n]生命のすべてを[n]つかさどる[n]のうかの女神でもあり[n]いのりが　とどけば[n]豊作になる[end]
en: A goddess who guards the earth and rules over all life. She's also a goddess of farming: if prayers reach her, the harvest is rich.[end]

jp: 真っ白な体を持つ[n]リュウの神[n]太陽を　つかさどり[n]体からあふれる[n]光はジャアクなものを[n]めっする[end]
en: A dragon god with a pure white body that rules over the sun. The light pouring from its body destroys all evil.[end]

jp: 体中が　とっても[n]やわらかい毛で[n]おおわれている[n]かわいらしい　デビル[n]だきしめると[n]幸福になれる[end]
en: An adorable demon covered all over in super-soft fur. Give it a hug and you'll be happy.[end]

jp: ハーピー３姉妹の長女[n]風をあやつり[n]疾風の名を持つデビル[n]セクシーなお姉さんで[n]その色気に　他の[n]デビルもメロメロ[end]
en: Eldest of three Harpy sisters, a wind demon named for the gale. She is a sexy big sister whose charm makes other demons swoon.[end]

jp: ハーピー３姉妹の次女[n]風をあやつり[n]速く飛ぶ女の名を持つ[n]名前の通り　目にも[n]とまらぬ　速さで[n]空を飛ぶことができる[end]
en: Second of the three Harpy sisters. She wields the wind, and her name means "swift flier." True to it, she flies too fast to see.[end]

jp: ハーピー３姉妹の三女[n]風をあやつり　黒い[n]女の名を持つデビル[n]まだまだお姉さんの[n]うしろをついてあるく[n]あまえんぼう[end]
en: Youngest of three Harpy sisters, a wind demon whose name means "dark one." Still a baby who tags after her big sisters.[end]

jp: 闇のパートナーとして[n]力に　めざめた[n]伝説の　闇のドラゴン[n]強力なツバサと爪を[n]武器に世界をほろぼす[n]悪と　戦う運命を持つ[n]闇のパートナーとして[n]力に　めざめた[n]伝説の　闇のドラゴン[n]強力な力とユウカンな[n]心を武器に　強大な[n]悪と　戦う運命を持つ[end]
en: A legendary dark dragon, awakened as a dark partner. With mighty wings and claws, it's fated to fight the evil that would end the world. A legendary dark dragon, awakened to its power as a dark partner. With great strength and courage, it's fated to fight a mighty evil.[end]

jp: 闇のパートナーとして[n]力に　めざめた[n]伝説の　闇のドラゴン[n]強力な力とユウカンな[n]心を武器に　強大な[n]悪と　戦う運命を持つ[end]
en: A legendary dark dragon, awakened to its power as a dark partner. With great strength and courage, it's fated to fight a mighty evil.[end]

jp: 光のパートナーとして[n]力に　めざめた[n]伝説の　光のライオン[n]強力なツバサと爪を[n]武器に世界をほろぼす[n]悪と　戦う運命を持つ[n]光のパートナーとして[n]力に　めざめた[n]伝説の　光のライオン[n]強力な力とユウカンな[n]心を武器に　強大な[n]悪と　戦う運命を持つ[end]
en: A legendary lion of light, awakened to its power as a light partner. With mighty wings and claws, it's fated to fight the evil that would end the world. A legendary lion of light, awakened to its power as a light partner. With great strength and courage, it's fated to fight a mighty evil.[end]

jp: 光のパートナーとして[n]力に　めざめた[n]伝説の　光のライオン[n]強力な力とユウカンな[n]心を武器に　強大な[n]悪と　戦う運命を持つ[end]
en: A legendary lion of light, awakened to its power as a light partner. With great strength and courage, it's fated to fight a mighty evil.[end]

jp: ガンジョウな体を[n]もち　大きなシタを[n]だして　わらいだす[n]ヨウキなデビル[n]赤ちゃんが　大好きで[n]命にかえても　守る[end]
en: A cheerful demon with a sturdy body that sticks out its big tongue and laughs. It loves babies and will protect them with its life.[end]

jp: 自分の姿を　好きに[n]けしたりあらわしたり[n]することが　できる[n]不思議なデビル[n]毒の息をはいて[n]人間を　苦しめる[end]
en: A mysterious demon that can vanish and reappear at will. It breathes poison to torment humans.[end]

jp: フロスト族のピンチに[n]魔界に　舞い降りる[n]伝説の　フロスト[n]その力はルシファーに[n]まさるともおとらない[n]らしい・・・[end]
en: A legendary Frost who descends on the Demon World whenever the Frost clan is in a pinch. They say its power is a match for Lucifer's...[end]

jp: 強い力を身に付けて[n]１人前になった[n]ケルベロス[n]体がすこし大きくなり[n]爪やキバも[n]するどくなった[end]
en: A Cerberus that has gained great power and come into its own. Its body has grown a bit bigger, and its claws and fangs sharper.[end]

jp: 魔界の力を吸収して[n]さらに成長した[n]ケルベロス[n]しゃくねつの力を[n]使いこなすことが[n]できるようになった[end]
en: A Cerberus that absorbed the Demon World's power and grew even more. It has mastered the power of scorching heat.[end]

jp: 成長に成長を重ねた[n]ケルベロスの[n]最終進化ケイタイ[n]どんな　デビルも[n]あまりの　強さに[n]おびえるという[end]
en: Cerberus's final evolved form, after growing and growing. They say every demon cowers before its overwhelming strength.[end]

jp: 体　イッパイに[n]大きな　勇気と[n]正義の　心を持つ[n]聖なる　ライオン[n]しゃくねつの炎で[n]敵をなぎはらう[end]
en: A holy lion whose body is brimming with great courage and a heart of justice. It sweeps away foes with scorching flames.[end]

jp: 大きな　体に[n]正義の　心と[n]ジュンスイな心を持つ[n]聖なる　ライオン[n]強大な　力は[n]敵をにがさない[end]
en: A holy lion with a huge body, a just heart and a pure soul. No foe escapes its immense power.[end]

jp: 時間すら　こえる力を[n]持っていると言われる[n]最強の　スフィンクス[n]正義の心と　力で[n]悪い　やつらを[n]ゆるさない[end]
en: The mightiest Sphinx, said to have power that transcends even time. With its just heart and strength, it never lets bad guys get away.[end]

jp: たくましく　成長し[n]１人前となった[n]グリフォン[n]風の魔法を　あやつる[n]力を　持っていると[n]言われている[end]
en: A Gryphon that has grown tough and come into its own. It's said to have power over wind magic.[end]

jp: 魔界のエネルギーを[n]とりこみ[n]進化したグリフォン[n]強風をあやつり[n]すべてをふきとばす[n]力を　持っている[end]
en: A Gryphon that took in the Demon World's energy and evolved. It controls fierce winds with the power to blow everything away.[end]

jp: 魔界に敵ナシと[n]いうほどに　成長した[n]グリフォンの[n]最終進化ケイタイ[n]神をこえた力を持つ[n]美しい　デビル[end]
en: Gryphon's final evolved form, grown so strong it has no rival in the Demon World. A beautiful demon with power beyond the gods.[end]

jp: 強い力を身につけて[n]１人前になった[n]キマイラ[n]強力になった[n]イナズマで　敵を[n]クロコゲにする[end]
en: A Chimera that has gained great power and come into its own. Its stronger lightning burns foes to a crisp.[end]

jp: 魔界の力を　吸収し[n]さらに進化した[n]キマイラ[n]あらたに手に入れた[n]大きなツバサで[n]敵をなぎはらう[end]
en: A Chimera that absorbed the Demon World's power and evolved further. It sweeps foes away with its newly gained great wings.[end]

jp: 進化をかさねた[n]キマイラの最終進化[n]の姿[n]リュウとヤギの首[n]ヘビのシッポを[n]手に入れた[end]
en: Chimera's final form after evolving again and again. It has gained dragon and goat heads and a snake's tail.[end]

jp: ナカマをまもるために[n]強い力を身につけた[n]１人前のフェニックス[n]とっても　すばやい[n]動きで　飛びまわり[n]敵をホンロウする[end]
en: A grown-up Phoenix that gained great power to protect its allies. It flies around super fast, running rings around its foes.[end]

jp: 魔界の力を吸収し[n]さらに進化した[n]フェニックス[n]地獄の力を[n]使えるようになって[n]さらにすばやくなった[end]
en: A Phoenix that absorbed the Demon World's power and evolved further. It can now use the power of Hell and is even faster.[end]

jp: 進化を続けて行き[n]魔界に敵ナシとまで[n]言われるようになった[n]フェニックスの[n]最終進化ケイタイ[n]炎の中でフッカツした[end]
en: Phoenix's final evolved form, so evolved it's called unrivaled in the Demon World. It was reborn in the flames.[end]

jp: 反乱軍のメンバーの[n]１人で　すさまじい[n]カイリキを　持つ[n]ミノタウロス[n]兄のガイと　ちがい[n]考えることがニガテ[end]
en: A member of the rebel army, a Minotaur with tremendous strength. Unlike his big brother Gai, he's no good at thinking.[end]

jp: 反乱軍のメンバーの[n]１人で　ほうふな[n]チシキとカイリキを[n]持つ　ミノタウロス[n]弟のブルと　違い[n]魔法も　得意である[end]
en: A member of the rebel army, a Minotaur with vast knowledge and great strength. Unlike his little brother Bull, he's good at magic too.[end]

jp: 悪いことをした[n]カッパが　変身した姿[n]とっても　チカラが[n]つよくて　カッパの[n]親分をしていることも[n]あるらしい[end]
en: What a Kappa becomes after doing bad deeds. It's super strong, and is sometimes the boss of the Kappas.[end]

jp: ジャングルの木の[n]てっぺんに　住む[n]ハチのデビル[n]ハチミツをとりにくる[n]人間に　おそいかかり[n]命を　うばってしまう[end]
en: A bee demon that lives at the tops of jungle trees. It attacks humans who come for its honey and takes their lives.[end]

jp: ほっかいどうの[n]大きな湖に　住む[n]リュウの神[n]体中から　くさい[n]ニオイがして近よると[n]毛が　ぬけてしまう[end]
en: A dragon god that lives in a big lake in Hokkaido. Its whole body stinks, and if you get close, your hair falls out.[end]

jp: しわだらけの黒い顔を[n]していて　おどりが[n]大好きな　デビル[n]手に持つ　大きな[n]トンカチで　どんな[n]ものでも　つくる[end]
en: A demon with a wrinkled black face that loves to dance. With the huge hammer in its hand, it can make anything.[end]

jp: 運動神経バツグンで[n]どんな運動もかるく[n]こなしてしまう[n]サルの神さま[n]ハヌマーンとは[n]大の仲良し[end]
en: A monkey god with amazing reflexes that breezes through any sport. It's best buddies with Hanuman.[end]

jp: 人と同じような　姿を[n]していて　トラの[n]シッポを持つ　山の神[n]雲をよび　雨をふらせ[n]豊作をよびよせる[n]ありがたい　神[end]
en: A mountain god shaped much like a human, with a tiger's tail. A welcome god who calls clouds and rain to bring rich harvests.[end]

jp: 眠っている人に[n]悪いユメを　みせる[n]メイワクなヨウセイの[n]女王さま[n]小さな　ヨウセイだが[n]戦いが　大好き[end]
en: A pesky fairy queen who gives sleeping people bad dreams. She's a tiny fairy, but she loves to fight.[end]

jp: 太陽をおいかけまわし[n]食べてしまうという[n]オオカミのデビル[n]兄弟であるハティとは[n]月が出るときにだけ[n]出会うことができる[end]
en: A wolf demon that chases the sun to eat it. It can only meet its brother Hati when the moon comes out.[end]

jp: 月をおいかけまわし[n]食べてしまうという[n]オオカミのデビル[n]兄弟の　スコールとは[n]太陽が出るときにだけ[n]出会うことができる[end]
en: A wolf demon said to chase down the moon and eat it. It can meet its brother Skoll only when the sun comes out.[end]

jp: 大地をつかさどる[n]キョウボウな　デビル[n]人間を　みかけると[n]食べてしまおうと[n]おいかけてくる[n]くいしんぼうデビル[end]
en: A ferocious demon that rules the earth. A greedy glutton that chases any human it sees to eat them up.[end]

jp: なんでも　飲みこむ[n]キョウボウな[n]デビルなのだが[n]このフェンリルは[n]めったにいない[n]めずらしいタイプ[end]
en: A ferocious demon that swallows anything, but this Fenrir is a rare type you hardly ever see.[end]

jp: 魔界の力で[n]大きくなった[n]ゾウリムシの中でも[n]ふつうのシュルイとは[n]すこしチガウ[n]めずらしい　タイプ[end]
en: Of all the Paramecia grown huge by the Demon World's power, this rare one is a bit different from the usual kind.[end]

jp: 魔界で　大人気の[n]ペットの　デビル[n]ふつうのメッチーより[n]さらに　めずらしい[n]デビルで　めったに[n]人前にあらわれない[end]
en: A pet demon hugely popular in the Demon World. Even rarer than a normal Mecchy, it seldom shows itself to people.[end]

jp: 長い時間をかけて[n]デビルになったネコ[n]ふつうのネコマタとは[n]すこしチガウけど[n]シッポが３つ[n]あるわけではない[end]
en: A cat that slowly became a demon over many years. It's a bit different from normal Nekomata, but no, it doesn't have three tails.[end]

jp: イタズラ好きな[n]小さいヨウセイ[n]イタズラばかり[n]していたら[n]すこし姿が[n]変わってしまった[end]
en: A tiny fairy who loves pranks. It pulled so many pranks that its looks changed a little.[end]

jp: 聖なる　角を[n]持っている[n]馬のセイレイ[n]ナゼか　ちょっとだけ[n]他のユニコーンとは[n]姿がチガウ[end]
en: A horse spirit with a holy horn. For some reason, it looks just a little different from other Unicorns.[end]

jp: 赤いバラがキライな[n]ワルイ心を[n]持ってしまった[n]ヴァーチャーで[n]その中でも　すこし[n]フンイキがチガウ[end]
en: A Virtue that hates red roses and has turned wicked at heart. Even among its kind, its air is a bit different.[end]

jp: なまけものが[n]大キライな[n]マジメな天使[n]ふつうのシュルイの[n]ドミニオンとは[n]すこしチガウ[end]
en: A serious angel who can't stand lazybones. It's a bit different from the usual kind of Dominion.[end]

jp: 天使たちの[n]リーダー格で[n]強い力を　持つ天使[n]その中でも[n]なんだかチョット[n]フンイキがチガウ[end]
en: A mighty angel who ranks as a leader among angels. Even so, something about its air is a little different.[end]

jp: 自分の頭をかかえて[n]人の死を教えにくる[n]死神の女の子[n]デュラハンの中でも[n]チョット変わり者で[n]見た目もすこしチガウ[end]
en: A reaper girl who carries her own head and comes to tell of death. An oddball even among Dullahans, she looks a bit different too.[end]

jp: 山にすむ　かわいい[n]コドモのヘビのデビル[n]その　オロチの中でも[n]カワリモノで[n]見た目も　チョット[n]チガッテいる[end]
en: A cute baby snake demon living in the mountains. An oddball even among Orochi, it looks a little different too.[end]

jp: ４つの顔と[n]４つの羽を持つ天使[n]ケルビムの中でも[n]チョットかわっていて[n]性格も姿も[n]すこしチガウ[end]
en: An angel with four faces and four wings. A bit unusual even among Cherubim, it differs a little in both nature and looks.[end]

jp: 人間の世界に[n]あこがれていて[n]海に住んでいる[n]女の子デビル[n]他のマーメイドとは[n]フンイキが少しチガウ[end]
en: A sea-dwelling girl demon who longs for the human world. Her air is a little different from other Mermaids.[end]

jp: 吸血鬼を　おいかける[n]バンパイアハンター[n]クルースニクは[n]長い戦いの中で[n]すこし姿が[n]変わった[end]
en: A vampire hunter who pursues bloodsuckers. This Kresnik's looks changed a little over its long battle.[end]

jp: スゴイスピードで走り[n]空をも飛ぶ　スゴイ馬[n]ふつうのシュルイ[n]ではなく　すこしだけ[n]めずらしい[n]スレイプニル[end]
en: An amazing horse that runs at amazing speed and even flies. Not the usual kind, this Sleipnir is a slightly rare one.[end]

jp: よい行いをした人間を[n]天国でおもてなしする[n]女神さま[n]１人に　７２人の[n]フーリーがいっぺんに[n]おもてなしする[end]
en: A goddess who welcomes good people in paradise. Each person is welcomed by 72 Houris all at once.[end]

jp: 悪さをする　人間を[n]毒ガスで　殺して[n]しまう　鉱山を守る神[n]岩を　とかすほどの[n]炎を　はきだすことが[n]できる[end]
en: A god who guards the mines and kills wicked humans with poison gas. It can breathe flames hot enough to melt rock.[end]

jp: 川に　住んでいて[n]ビーバーのような姿を[n]している　デビル[n]オスのウシがニガテで[n]見ただけで[n]にげだしてしまう[end]
en: A demon that lives in rivers and looks like a beaver. It can't stand bulls and runs away at the mere sight of one.[end]

jp: 冷気を　あやつる[n]大地のセイレイ[n]人をおどろかせるのが[n]大好きで　それに[n]命をかけている[end]
en: An earth spirit that controls the cold. It loves startling people and has bet its whole life on it.[end]

jp: 森のセイレイで[n]前から　見ると[n]キレイな女の人だが[n]背中には　木が[n]生えている[n]実はさみしがりや[end]
en: A forest spirit who looks like a lovely woman from the front, but has a tree growing from her back. She gets lonely easily.[end]

jp: 空を　飛ぶことが[n]できる　ゾウのデビル[n]やさしい　性格を[n]していて　人間を[n]おそうことはけっして[n]ないと　されている[end]
en: An elephant demon that can fly through the sky. It has a gentle nature and is said never to attack humans.[end]

jp: 太陽の神の　愛馬で[n]光かがやくたてがみが[n]トレードマーク[n]背中に　のれば[n]どんな場所でも[n]走ることが　できる[end]
en: The beloved steed of the sun god, known for its shining mane. Ride on its back, and it can run anywhere.[end]

jp: 上半身が　女性で[n]下半身が　ヘビの姿を[n]しているすさまじい[n]チカラを持つデビル[n]まだ　完全には[n]めざめていない[end]
en: A demon of tremendous power with a woman's upper body and a snake's lower body. It has not yet fully awakened.[end]

jp: はるか　ムカシに[n]フウインされた[n]太陽と戦いの神[n]まだ　本当のチカラは[n]めざめていない[end]
en: A god of the sun and war, sealed away long, long ago. Its true power has not yet awakened.[end]

jp: はるか　ムカシに[n]フウインされた[n]人間の血を吸って[n]生きているデビル[n]まだ　本来のチカラは[n]眠っている[end]
en: A demon that lives by drinking human blood, sealed away long, long ago. Its true power still sleeps.[end]

jp: はるか　ムカシに[n]フウインされた[n]地獄のショウグン[n]フウインが　まだ[n]完全にとかれていない[end]
en: A general of Hell, sealed away long, long ago. Its seal has not yet been fully broken.[end]

jp: はるか　ムカシに[n]フウインされた[n]サソリのデビル[n]長い　ネムリから[n]まだ　さめていない[end]
en: A scorpion demon, sealed away long, long ago. It has not yet woken from its long sleep.[end]

jp: 多くの　デビルを[n]生み出した母なる[n]デビル[n]すさまじいチカラで[n]どんなデビルも[n]にげだしてしまう[end]
en: The mother demon who gave birth to many demons. Her tremendous power makes any demon run away.[end]

jp: フウインが　とけた[n]太陽と戦いの神[n]太陽の炎で　きたえ[n]あげた　剣は[n]どんなものでも[n]一刀両断してしまう[end]
en: A god of the sun and war, freed from its seal. Its sword, forged in the sun's flames, cuts anything clean in two.[end]

jp: フウインが　とけた[n]のろわれた花のデビル[n]このデビルが[n]家にいると　夢の中に[n]キレイな　女の人が[n]でてくるという[end]
en: A cursed flower demon, freed from its seal. They say if it's in your house, a lovely woman appears in your dreams.[end]

jp: フウインが　とけた[n]地獄のショウグン[n]過去・現在・未来を[n]みとおすチカラをもち[n]魔法使いに　色々な[n]チカラを　あたえる[end]
en: A general of Hell, freed from its seal. It sees past, present and future, and grants magicians all sorts of powers.[end]

jp: 長いネムリからさめた[n]サソリのデビル[n]手のハサミは　どんな[n]モノでも　せつだんし[n]シッポは　モウドクを[n]もっている[end]
en: A scorpion demon woken from its long sleep. Its claws can slice through anything, and its tail holds deadly poison.[end]

jp: 空をとぶ　ツバサを[n]背中にもち　２匹の[n]ネコといっしょに[n]くらしている[n]とても美しい愛の女神[end]
en: A very beautiful goddess of love with wings on her back for flying. She lives together with two cats.[end]

jp: いつもは　人間の姿で[n]夜になるとオオカミに[n]変身する　デビル[n]かみつかれると[n]その人もワーウルフに[n]なってしまう[end]
en: A demon that usually looks human but turns into a wolf at night. Anyone it bites becomes a Werewolf too.[end]

jp: 魔法を　はねかえす[n]魔法のタテを　持つ[n]軍隊の神[n]ルールに　きびしく[n]やぶった者には[n]おしおきをする[end]
en: A god of armies with a magic shield that reflects spells. It is strict about rules and punishes those who break them.[end]

jp: 樹木を守る　雷の神[n]大きな体からは[n]想像がつかない[n]速さで　動くことが[n]でき　多くの武器を[n]つかうことができる[end]
en: A thunder god who protects the trees. It moves faster than its huge body suggests and can use many weapons.[end]

jp: 白いタケ馬にのって[n]あらわれる軍隊の神[n]タケ馬は　生きていて[n]大の仲良し[n]いつも　遊んでばかり[n]いる　いたずらっこ[end]
en: A god of armies who rides a white bamboo horse. The horse is alive and they're best friends. A prankster always playing around.[end]

jp: たんぼに住む[n]大地の　セイレイ[n]なまけ者を見つけると[n]おこりだす　とっても[n]まじめなデビル[n]家族を大切にしている[end]
en: An earth spirit living in rice paddies. A very serious demon who gets mad at lazybones. It cares deeply for its family.[end]

jp: イタズラが大好きな[n]天空の火の神[n]サメにするどいキバを[n]あたえたり　人間に[n]わざわいをあたえる[n]こまった神さま[end]
en: A heavenly fire god who loves pranks. A troublesome god who gave sharks sharp fangs and brings disaster on humans.[end]

jp: 水の中でチカラをだす[n]ワニのデビル[n]神につられそうに[n]なったときに　背中に[n]ついたキズが　ワニの[n]ギザギザになった[end]
en: A crocodile demon strongest in water. The cuts on its back from when a god nearly fished it up became its jagged ridges.[end]

jp: 太陽とゆたかさの女神[n]ツクヨミとスサノオは[n]兄弟である[n]彼女が泣き出すと[n]太陽は　姿をかくし[n]出てこなくなる[end]
en: Goddess of the sun and plenty. Tsukuyomi and Susano-o are her siblings. When she cries, the sun hides and won't come out.[end]

jp: 月をつかさどる神[n]アマテラスと[n]スサノオは兄弟[n]人間の気持ちを[n]自由にあやつることが[n]できる[end]
en: The god who rules the moon. Amaterasu and Susano-o are its siblings. It can freely control people's feelings.[end]

jp: 大きな体を持ち[n]６本の足を　持つ[n]トカゲのデビル[n]夜しか　行動せずに[n]肉しか　たべない[n]グルメな　デビル[end]
en: A lizard demon with a huge body and six legs. A gourmet demon that moves only at night and eats nothing but meat.[end]

jp: 白銀の車輪の名をもつ[n]時をつかさどる　女神[n]地上にあふれる[n]あらそいを[n]手から流れ出る[n]にじで　うちはらった[end]
en: A goddess of time whose name means silver wheel. She swept away the strife on earth with rainbows flowing from her hands.[end]

jp: 永遠にもえるという[n]炎の中に住んでいる[n]かまどの神さま[n]聖なる炎で　国を[n]守っている[end]
en: A hearth god who lives in flames said to burn forever. It protects its land with holy fire.[end]

jp: コウモリのような[n]ツバサを持つ美しい[n]ドラゴンのセイレイ[n]ひたいにある宝石を[n]手に入れた者は[n]魔法が　使えるという[end]
en: A beautiful dragon spirit with bat-like wings. Whoever gets the jewel on its forehead can use magic, they say.[end]

jp: 戦争のあとにのこった[n]人間のホネがあつまり[n]大きなドクロになった[n]昼間は姿を　かくし[n]夜になると　人間を[n]おそう[end]
en: Human bones left behind by wars gathered into a giant skull. It hides by day and attacks humans at night.[end]

jp: 世界を　ほろぼすと[n]人間をおどかして[n]よろこんでいる[n]悪い　夜の女神[n]ケツアルカトルが[n]大きらい[end]
en: A wicked goddess of night who loves scaring humans by saying she'll destroy the world. She hates Quetzalcoatl.[end]

jp: 目がまったく見えない[n]兵隊デビル[n]手にもっているヤリは[n]世界の王になる人間が[n]もつといわれる[n]伝説のヤリ[end]
en: A totally blind soldier demon. Its spear is a legendary one said to belong to whoever becomes king of the world.[end]

jp: すさまじい剣技を[n]ほこる　王様[n]どんな敵にもけっして[n]負けることがない[n]手にもつ　剣とタテは[n]けっして　こわれない[end]
en: A king proud of his fearsome swordplay, who never loses to any foe. His sword and shield will never break.[end]

jp: 真っ黒な炎のヨロイで[n]身をつつみ　世界を[n]ハカイするデビル[n]その手にふれられると[n]たくさんの病気に[n]なってしまう[end]
en: A demon clad in armor of pitch-black flame that destroys the world. One touch of its hand brings a host of diseases.[end]

jp: 風のセイレイ界に住む[n]セイレイ王[n]とてもきむずかしくて[n]さみしがりや[n]めずらしいものが[n]大好き[end]
en: The spirit king of the wind spirits' realm. Very hard to please and easily lonely, he loves rare things.[end]

jp: 時計のパーツを[n]よせあつめて[n]てっぺきのぼうぎょを[n]かためる正義のデビル[n]手からでるビームは[n]とっても強力[end]
en: A demon of justice that gathers clock parts into an ironclad defense. The beams from its hands are super strong.[end]

jp: だれよりもはやく[n]走ることを　夢みて[n]まい日トレーニングを[n]かかさない[n]まじめな　デビル[n]言葉づかいはヘン！？[end]
en: A serious demon who dreams of running faster than anyone and never skips a day of training. Its way of talking is weird!?[end]

jp: マボロシをみせて[n]人間の心をためす[n]ふしぎな　デビル[n]不気味な　カオを[n]しているが　けっして[n]悪いことは　しない[end]
en: A mysterious demon that tests human hearts with illusions. It has a creepy face, but it never does anything bad.[end]

jp: 心やさしい人間の[n]前にだけ　姿を見せる[n]めずらしい　ハートの[n]双子デビル[n]いつも　なかよく[n]遊んでいるらしい[end]
en: Rare heart twin demons that appear only before kind-hearted people. They're always playing happily together, it seems.[end]

jp: ミカエルすらこえる[n]チカラをもつと[n]ウワサされる　天使[n]好戦的な部分もあるが[n]ふだんはとっても[n]やさしい[end]
en: An angel rumored to have power beyond even Michael's. It has a warlike side, but is usually very kind.[end]

jp: エノクと兄弟の天使[n]人間のタマシイが[n]危機におちいった時に[n]助けてくれるという[n]やさしい　天使[n]色々な魔法を使う[end]
en: An angel and brother of Enoch. A kind angel said to help human souls in danger. It uses all sorts of magic.[end]

jp: エノクと兄弟の天使[n]平和と正義を愛する[n]熱血　天使[n]魔法は少しニガテだが[n]そのすさまじい剣技は[n]目にも　とまらない[end]
en: An angel and brother of Enoch. A hot-blooded angel who loves peace and justice. Weak at magic, but its swordplay is too fast to see.[end]
